title: Student Account Claim & Password Reset Fix (v0.4.32)
message: Resolves claimed student status display and temporary password reset flow in Web Admin Portal and Android app.
changelog:
🔧 WHAT'S NEW IN v0.4.32 (STUDENT ACCOUNT CLAIM & PASSWORD RESET FIX):
• Fixed Claimed Student Status: Claimed student accounts in the Web Admin Portal now correctly display 'Claimed in App' with protected password masking (••••••••).
• Restored Password Reset Flow: Teachers and School Admins can generate temporary passkeys with reliable activation in both Web Admin Portal and mobile app.
• Direct Homeroom Class Enrollment: Automatically associates newly claimed and signed-in students with their homeroom adviser's section and subject list.
• Security Rules Enhancement: Added granular permissions for student credential migration and class auto-enrollment.
